units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Lamentations 5:15">Targ. Lam. V, 15</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Sotah 33a:8">Sot. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>בטילת עבידתא וכ׳</he> the decree enforcing idol worship in the Temple has been repealed. Meg. Taan. XI on the twenty second (of Shebat) <he>ב׳ עבידתא</he> was the decree &c. revoked.
<cite ref="Shabbat 139a:6">Sabb. 139ᵃ</cite>, <cite ref="Sanhedrin 98a:9">Snh. 98ᵃ</cite> <he>אי בטלי וכ׳</he>; v. <cite ref="A01980"><he>אַמְגּוֹשָׁא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 18b:15">R. Hash. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>בטילת אדכרתא</he> (Meg. Taan. VII <he>אתנטילת</he>, read <he>אתב׳</he>), v. <cite ref="A00413"><he>אַדְכַּרְתָּא</he></cite>; a. fr.—2) as h. Kal 2).
Targ. Y. Ex. XVII, 1 [read:] דבְטִילוּ אידיהון when their hands were lazy &c.—Part. pass. בָּטִיל annulled; neutralized (in a larger quantity, v. preced. Pi.).

<cite ref="Chullin 100a:8">Ḥull. 100ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. (in Hebr. phraseol.) <he>מין במינו לא ב׳</he> in a mixture of homogeneous things (of which one is forbidden) the rule of neutralization by quantity takes no effect.
<cite ref="Chullin 99a:3">Ib. 99ᵃ</cite> <he>ברובא ב׳</he> it is neutralized in any larger quantity (than the forbidden ingredient); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Chullin 100a:8">Ib. 100ᵃ</cite> top <he>ותבטיל</he>, v. Ithpe.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 33:10">Targ. Ps. XXXIII, 10</cite> (some ed. incorr. <cite ref="B00510"><he>בְּטִיל</he></cite>); a. e.—

<cite ref="Eruvin 66b:14">Erub. 66ᵇ</cite> <he>למאן נִיבַטֵּיל</he> to whom should he resign his right of usage (for Sabbath purposes)? <he>לִיבַטֵּיל וכ׳</he> shall he resign &c.? Ib. 67ᵃ <he>בַּטּוּלֵי … מְבַטֵיל</he>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 6b:15">Pes. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>לְבַטְּלֵיה</he> let him renounce it (the leavened thing).
<cite ref="Pesachim 6b:17">Ib.</cite> <he>וניבטליה בארבע</he> let him renounce it at four hours of the day.
<cite ref="Gittin 36b:9">Gitt. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>אֲבַטְּלִינֵיה</he> I would repeal it (that law).
<cite ref="Gittin 32a:9">Ib. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>דבטולי בטליה</he> that he revoked it (the letter of divorce); a. fr.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 6:7">Targ. Y. Gen. VI, 7</cite> 1) = Pa.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 6:7">Targ. Y. Gen. VI, 7</cite> <he>אַבְטִיל</he> I will undo (h. text <he>אמחה</he>); a. e.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 30:11">Targ. Is. XXX, 11</cite> <he>אַבְטְלוּנָא מ־</he> make ye us free from tradition.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 17:11">Targ. Job XVII, 11</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Gittin 32a:3">Gitt. 32ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Gittin 32b:9">32ᵇ</cite> <cite ref="B00515"><he>בָּטֵל</he></cite> has two meanings <he>משמע דבטל ומשמע דלִיבְּטִיל</he> it may mean ‘it is void’, and may mean ‘be it declared void’.
<cite ref="Chullin 100a:8">Ḥull. 100ᵃ</cite> <he>ותבְּטִיל ברובא</he> (or <he>ותִבְטִיל</he>) let it be neutralized in the larger mixture; (why is it not &c.?)

senses.gloss: to be disturbed, to be forced to be idle.
